donor.name: RAIL
donor.purpose: Convert a polynomial over-approximation plus polynomially many sound obstruction cuts into an exact polynomial solver by refinement and bounded recursion.

theorem_contract.R1: Polynomial exact over-approximation map from concrete solutions to abstract solutions.
theorem_contract.R2: Exact lower-level solver; recursion height fixed independent of input size.
theorem_contract.R3: Polynomial lift attempt returns verified concrete solution or spurious certificate.
theorem_contract.R4: Every cut is valid for all concrete solutions and excludes current abstract witness.
theorem_contract.R5: Polynomial obstruction basis separates every non-liftable abstract witness and returns a fresh cut.
theorem_contract.R6: All abstract states, cuts, histories and certificates remain polynomial size.

authority.prerequisite: R1-R6 MUST BE PROVED FOR THE INPUT CLASS
authority.ceiling: GENERIC META-SOLVER ONLY; DOES NOT ASSERT THREE-SHEET HAS A POLYNOMIAL OBSTRUCTION BASIS
